The fix reuses the shared _record_worktree reader rather than introducing a second spelling of the guard, matching the neighbouring readers at lines 621/656/717/1075/3078. Residual: the test exercises the loop through a synthesized fleet, not a real one, which is the correct isolation but leaves the live-path wiring covered only by the population arm.
justifications.evidence: Independently reproduced, not taken on trust. The run's own population arm over the 60 files importing reckon.crew.promotion is 1 failed/539 passed at the reverted site and 540 passed/EXIT=0 at head. Ruff on the changed source is unchanged (3 findings both sides; the diff is a line-number shift only). The base arm is a revert arm rather than a pristine base, so the added-failure count is derived against a synthetic base.
justifications.fit: Lands exactly where section 56 pointed - the last site of the idiom in promotion.py - and closes the section's no-unguarded-instance clause. It uses the existing worktree reader the rest of the file uses, introduces no name the repository forbids, and records its own landing in a fragment with the red-arm result and the grep finding. The residual Path(str(record.get("worktree") or ".")) sites in recovery.py, resumption.py and dispatch.py deliberately default to the process directory and are a different, intended idiom outside this section.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The change lands exactly at the site the sibling review recorded as the last unguarded instance of the idiom (promotion.py:3114 in that record, now 3119). Before, Path(str(pointer.get("worktree") or "")).resolve() made a blank field the promotion's own starting directory, so a blank pointer's declared write paths were granted to a legitimately held tree and an uncommitted edit there escaped the walk. After, _record_worktree returns None for a blank field and the loop skips it. The closing clause of the section is met: the exact-idiom grep returns one match, resumption.py:1245, whose next line's `not str(pointer.get("worktree") or "")` disjunct short-circuits a blank before Path("") is used.
justifications.scope_discipline: The diff touches exactly reckon/crew/promotion.py, tests/test_promotion_last_blank_worktree_site.py and docs/evidence/fragments/crew-runtime-positive-controls/the-last-blank-worktree-idiom-in-promotion.html - all within the declared write paths. The figures directory was declared but not produced, which the done-when does not require. No other plan, index or sibling store is touched. The change adds no ruff finding.
